title: Aequitas: A Bias and Fairness Audit Toolkit
findings: The paper presents a toolkit, Aequitas, designed to audit for unintended bias based on protected characteristics including religion. However, the case studies presented in the paper do not include an analysis of religious bias, focusing instead on race, gender, and age. Therefore, there are no empirical findings related to religion.
